sections.content: At B1, travel communication requires more than naming places or asking for directions. A traveller may need to explain what happened, describe a problem, propose an alternative, discuss a future plan and express a hypothetical consequence. These functions can be combined in connected speech when a journey does not go exactly as planned.

items.spanish: Habíamos reservado el alojamiento, pero el tren llegó tarde y perdimos la conexión.
items.english: We had booked the accommodation, but the train arrived late and we missed the connection.

items.spanish: Si encontramos una alternativa, continuaremos el viaje esta noche.
items.english: If we find an alternative, we will continue the journey tonight.

items.spanish: Nos dirigimos al centro, aunque todavía no sabíamos dónde pasaríamos la noche.
items.english: We headed towards the centre, although we still did not know where we would spend the night.

items.spanish: La travesía fue difícil, pero conseguimos superar los problemas que surgieron.
items.english: The journey was difficult, but we managed to overcome the problems that arose.

sections.content: In a real travel situation, combine functions: explain the problem, give the relevant background, state the next plan and discuss an alternative if necessary.
